audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Jericho siege, herem, Rahab rescue, and rebuilding-curse narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for closed city, seven-day procession, ram-horn trumpets, shouted collapse, total-destruction command, Rahab's household sanctuary, treasury metals, city burning, and curse on rebuilding.

verses.restored: Jericho was shut and tightly closed because of children of Israel; none went out and none came in.

familiar.text: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

modern.text: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

original.text: וִֽירִיחוֹ֙ סֹגֶ֣רֶת וּמְסֻגֶּ֔רֶת מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ין יוֹצֵ֖א וְאֵ֥ין בָּֽא

verses.restored: YHWH said to Joshua, See, I have given into your hand Jericho and its king, mighty men of strength.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

modern.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand, along with its king and its mighty men of valor.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי בְיָֽדְךָ֔ אֶת יְרִיח֖וֹ וְאֶת מַלְכָּ֑הּ גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י הֶחָֽיִל

verses.restored: You shall circle city, all men of war, going around city once; thus you shall do six days.

familiar.text: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

modern.text: March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.

original.text: וְסַבֹּתֶ֣ם אֶת הָעִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַקֵּ֥יף אֶת הָעִ֖יר פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים

verses.restored: Seven priests shall carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before ark; on seventh day you shall circle city seven times, and priests shall blow trumpets.

familiar.text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

modern.text: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark. Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times, while the priests blow the horns.

original.text: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹהֲנִ֡ים יִשְׂאוּ֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י תָּסֹ֥בּוּ אֶת הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת

verses.restored: It shall be, when they make a long blast with ram's horn, when you hear sound of trumpet, all people shall shout a great shout, and wall of city shall fall under itself, and people shall go up, each man straight before him.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

modern.text: And when there is a long blast of the ram’s horn and you hear its sound, have all the people give a mighty shout. Then the wall of the city will collapse and all your people will charge straight into the city. ”

original.text: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ בְּקֶ֣רֶן הַיּוֹבֵ֗ל בשמעכם אֶת ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר יָרִ֥יעוּ כָל הָעָ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָעִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ וְעָל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Joshua son of Nun called priests and said to them, Carry ark of covenant, and seven priests shall carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before ark of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD.

modern.text: So Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said, “Take up the ark of the covenant and have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD.”

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ אֶל הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם שְׂא֖וּ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹֽהֲנִ֗ים יִשְׂאוּ֙ שִׁבְעָ֤ה שֽׁוֹפְרוֹת֙ יוֹבְלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He said to people, Pass on and circle city, and armed force shall pass before ark of YHWH.

familiar.text: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.

modern.text: And he told the people, “Advance and march around the city, with the armed troops going ahead of the ark of the LORD.”

original.text: ויאמרו אֶל הָעָ֔ם עִבְר֖וּ וְסֹ֣בּוּ אֶת הָעִ֑יר וְהֶ֣חָל֔וּץ יַעֲבֹ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: It was, when Joshua spoke to people, seven priests carrying seven trumpets of rams' horns before YHWH passed on and blew trumpets, and ark of covenant of YHWH went after them.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

modern.text: After Joshua had spoken to the people, seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the horns, and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י כֶּאֱמֹ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אֶל הָעָם֒ וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָבְר֕וּ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַֽאֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Armed force went before priests blowing trumpets, and rear guard went after ark, going and blowing trumpets.

familiar.text: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

modern.text: While the horns continued to sound, the armed troops marched ahead of the priests who blew the horns, and the rear guard followed the ark.

original.text: וְהֶחָל֣וּץ הֹלֵ֔ךְ לִפְנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים תקעו הַשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן הָל֖וֹךְ וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת

verses.restored: Joshua commanded people, saying, You shall not shout or make your voice heard, and no word shall go out from your mouth until day I say to you, Shout; then you shall shout.

familiar.text: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

modern.text: But Joshua had commanded the people: “Do not give a battle cry or let your voice be heard; do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you are to shout!”

original.text: וְאֶת הָעָם֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹ֤א תָרִ֨יעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא תַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶת קוֹלְכֶ֔ם וְלֹא יֵצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֣וֹם אָמְרִ֧י אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הָרִ֖יעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶֽם

verses.restored: Ark of YHWH circled city, going around once; then they came into camp and lodged in camp.

familiar.text: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

modern.text: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.

original.text: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב אֲרוֹן יְהוָה֙ אֶת הָעִ֔יר הַקֵּ֖ף פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה

verses.restored: Joshua rose early in morning, and priests carried ark of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

modern.text: Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests took the ark of the LORD.

original.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Seven priests carrying seven trumpets of rams' horns before ark of YHWH went continually and blew trumpets; armed force went before them and rear guard went after ark of YHWH, going and blowing trumpets.

familiar.text: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

modern.text: And the seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns kept marching ahead of the ark of the LORD and blowing the horns. The armed troops went in front of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the LORD, while the horns kept sounding.

original.text: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֜וֹת הַיֹּבְלִ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הֹלְכִ֣ים הָל֔וֹךְ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הולך וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת

verses.restored: They circled city on second day once and returned to camp; thus they did six days.

familiar.text: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

modern.text: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

original.text: וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ אֶת הָעִ֜יר בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשֵּׁנִי֙ פַּ֣עַם אַחַ֔ת וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים

verses.restored: It was on seventh day that they rose early at dawning of morning and circled city in this manner seven times; only on that day they circled city seven times.

familiar.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

modern.text: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times in the same manner. That was the only day they circled the city seven times.

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַיַּשְׁכִּ֨מוּ֙ כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔חַר וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ אֶת הָעִ֛יר כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים רַ֚ק בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא סָבְב֥וּ אֶת הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים

verses.restored: It was at seventh time, when priests blew trumpets, Joshua said to people, Shout, for YHWH has given you city.

familiar.text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

modern.text: After the seventh time around, the priests blew the horns, and Joshua commanded the people, “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ית תָּקְע֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל הָעָם֙ הָרִ֔יעוּ כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת הָעִֽיר

verses.restored: The city shall be devoted to destruction, it and all in it, to YHWH; only Rahab the prostitute/sex worker shall live, she and all who are with her in house, because she hid messengers whom we sent.

familiar.text: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

modern.text: Now the city and everything in it must be devoted to the LORD for destruction. Only Rahab the prostitute and all those with her in her house will live, because she hid the spies we sent.

original.text: וְהָיְתָ֨ה הָעִ֥יר חֵ֛רֶם הִ֥יא וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖הּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה רַק֩ רָחָ֨ב הַזּוֹנָ֜ה תִּֽחְיֶ֗ה הִ֚יא וְכָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֣הּ בַּבַּ֔יִת כִּ֣י הֶחְבְּאַ֔תָה אֶת הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלָֽחְנוּ

verses.restored: Only you, guard yourselves from devoted thing, lest you devote and take from devoted thing and make camp of Israel devoted and trouble it.

familiar.text: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

modern.text: But keep away from the things devoted to destruction, lest you yourself be set apart for destruction. If you take any of these, you will set apart the camp of Israel for destruction and bring disaster upon it.

original.text: וְרַק אַתֶּם֙ שִׁמְר֣וּ מִן הַחֵ֔רֶם פֶּֽן תַּחֲרִ֖ימוּ וּלְקַחְתֶּ֣ם מִן הַחֵ֑רֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֞ם אֶת מַחֲנֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֵ֔רֶם וַעֲכַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: All silver and gold and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to YHWH; into treasury of YHWH they shall come.

familiar.text: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.

modern.text: For all the silver and gold and all the articles of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD; they must go into His treasury.”

original.text: וְכֹ֣ל כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב וּכְלֵ֤י נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ וּבַרְזֶ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה אוֹצַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה יָבֽוֹא

verses.restored: The people shouted and trumpets were blown. It was, when people heard sound of trumpet and people shouted a great shout, that wall fell under itself, and people went up into city, each man straight before him, and captured city.

familiar.text: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

modern.text: So when the rams’ horns sounded, the people shouted. When they heard the blast of the horn, the people gave a great shout, and the wall collapsed. Then all the people charged straight into the city and captured it.

original.text: וַיָּ֣רַע הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּתְקְע֖וּ בַּשֹּֽׁפָר֑וֹת וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ הָעָ֜ם אֶת ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֗ר וַיָּרִ֤יעוּ הָעָם֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַתִּפֹּ֨ל הַֽחוֹמָ֜ה תַּחְתֶּ֗יהָ וַיַּ֨עַל הָעָ֤ם הָעִ֨ירָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ נֶגְדּ֔וֹ וַֽיִּלְכְּד֖וּ אֶת הָעִֽיר

verses.restored: They devoted to destruction all that was in city, from man to woman, from young to old, even ox, sheep, and donkey, by edge of sword.

familiar.text: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

modern.text: At the edge of the sword they devoted to destruction everything in the city—man and woman, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys.

original.text: וַֽיַּחֲרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר מֵאִישׁ֙ וְעַד אִשָּׁ֔ה מִנַּ֖עַר וְעַד זָקֵ֑ן וְעַ֨ד שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֛ה וַחֲמ֖וֹר לְפִי חָֽרֶב

verses.restored: To two men who spied land Joshua said, Go into house of woman, the prostitute/sex worker, and bring out from there the woman and all belonging to her, as you swore to her.

familiar.text: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

modern.text: Meanwhile, Joshua told the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the house of the prostitute and bring out the woman and all who are with her, just as you promised her.”

original.text: וְלִשְׁנַ֨יִם הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הַֽמְרַגְּלִ֤ים אֶת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בֹּ֖אוּ בֵּית הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזּוֹנָ֑ה וְהוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִשָּׁ֤ם אֶת הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּ֖ם לָֽהּ

verses.restored: The young men, spies, went in and brought out Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and all belonging to her; all her clans they brought out, and they placed them outside camp of Israel.

familiar.text: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

modern.text: So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers, and all who belonged to her. They brought out her whole family and settled them outside the camp of Israel.

verses.restored: The city and all in it they burned with fire; only silver and gold and vessels of bronze and iron they gave to treasury of house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

modern.text: Then the Israelites burned up the city and everything in it. However, they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.

verses.restored: Rahab the prostitute/sex worker and house of her father and all belonging to her Joshua preserved alive; she has dwelt in midst of Israel to this day, because she hid messengers Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

familiar.text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

modern.text: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho. So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.

verses.restored: Joshua made them swear at that time, saying, Cursed before YHWH is man who rises and rebuilds this city, Jericho. With his firstborn he shall lay its foundation, and with his youngest he shall set up its gates.

familiar.text: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

modern.text: At that time Joshua invoked this solemn oath: “Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho; at the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”

familiar.text: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

modern.text: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

original.text: וַיְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיְהִ֥י שָׁמְע֖וֹ בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ

translation_notes: Jericho is presented as a sealed civilian city under siege, not merely a military outpost.
The seven-day procession combines liturgical numbers, ark, trumpets, silence, and shout; archaeology and chronology concerning Jericho remain heavily debated and must not be overstated.
Herem in verses 17 and 21 means devotion to destruction. The text explicitly includes men, women, children, older people, and animals, and must never be sanitized as a bloodless victory.
Rahab and her extended household are spared because of the sworn covenant. Their rescue does not morally compensate for or justify the killing of everyone else.
Silver, gold, bronze, and iron are transferred to YHWH's treasury while living beings are destroyed, exposing the morally disturbing economics of sacred war.
Rahab's continued identification by occupation must not stigmatize sex workers or diminish her covenant agency.
The rebuilding curse places the builder's children into the cost of urban restoration and must not be used as a magical threat or justification for harm to descendants.
The chapter's fame-and-presence conclusion reports the victor's theology and does not erase the dead of Jericho.
safety_note: Never use Joshua 6 to justify genocide, child killing, religious war, siege against civilians, destruction of animals, looting under sacred language, curses against descendants, or stigma toward sex workers. Preserve the source under categorical moral protest, keep Jericho's victims visible, and honor Rahab's rescue without turning one sanctuary into an excuse for mass death.
